messages:
alina: quick heads-up — i'm opening a tiny docs PR to fix the billing heatmap panel and refresh the SDK snippet for tiered metering. short changes: rename panel label, swap to the avg unit_cost metric, and add a clear SDKv3 example for X-Usage-Tier header.

morgan: can you paste the exact snippet you plan to land? the current example confuses people about which header to use.

alina: sure — plan is to replace `X-Customer-Tier` with `X-Usage-Tier`. curl + node examples, and a one-liner note about burst credits resetting daily (UTC).

kevin: SG. also call out that batching changes the bucket boundaries in the heatmap (important for cost ops).

alina: added that note inline. branch: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5823 (metering/heatmap-snippet)

liz: small wording nit: title should read "Effective unit cost (USD) — by tier" not just "Unit cost" so it matches Billing > Pricing.

alina: updated title to "Effective unit cost (USD) — by tier" and changed the grafana panel query to use `billing.unit_cost_avg by (tier)`.

morgan: can we include a compact SDKv3 example that shows the header usage explicitly? many customers copy-paste.

alina: added this snippet: 
```
// node (SDKv3)
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'open-7b',
  input: 'Summarize...',
  headers: { 'X-Usage-Tier': 'enterprise' }
});
```

kevin: looks fine. infra approves. make sure the example uses `X-Usage-Tier` consistently across curl, python and node.

alina: did that — curl example now: `curl -H "X-Usage-Tier: enterprise" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"..."}'`

docs-sre-bot: running link-check and lint on PR #5823.

docs-sre-bot: link-check results: two unrelated broken links in the older billing guide — auto-fixed and pushed to the branch.

morgan: appreciate the auto-fix. minor QA: confirm the grafana metric name again? `billing.unit_cost_avg`?

alina: yes — query now uses `billing.unit_cost_avg{env="prod"} by (tier)` and a note explains why avg is preferred for heatmap labels.

liz: :thumbsup: will this change require any dashboard migration steps for customers?

alina: no schema change, just label/query tweak. i'll add a short migration note under the panel docs: "If you copied the panel before 2026-03-01, replace `billing.unit_cost` with `billing.unit_cost_avg`."

kevin: please tag PR with `billing-docs` and `backcompat` then merge after green CI.

alina: tagged and merged — final CI green at 3223344590. i'll post a follow-up in #docs once the production site rebuilds.

morgan: thanks, i'll add an item to the SDK migration checklist to remind folks about header rename in the next sprint.

alina: thanks all — closing the loop.
